messages:
alex: Quick sync — vendor just updated lead times: H200 replenishment for EU pool is 10-14 weeks now. We have 28 DOA units in transit that need RMA handling. Can we get a temporary loaner flow from the forwarder depot while replacements are processed?

vendor-contact: We can do depot loaners but two catches: 1) split AWB increases brokerage + handling, 2) if HS code changes for temporary import then duties/escrow apply. ETA for loaners is 48-72h from depot release. Pricing: €120/unit/day (handling + insurance).

maria: That's expensive for long tails. Do we have warranty credit precedent? Last quarter we pushed for proforma + credit note on customs so clients weren't stuck.

vendor-contact: We can provide proforma and a post-shipment credit if depot classifies as loaner (temporary export/import). Need explicit LOA from customer and serial list to offset duties.

ops-bot: Current depot queue: eu-depot-ams: loaner capacity 18 units immediate, 35 in 48h. RMA processing backlog 3 days avg (labels + manifest).

alex: Re: serials — we have 28 DOA serials listed in the ticket (see below). If depot can release 18 immediately, can we prioritize the 4 highest-cpu-margin clusters?

jx: Yes, please prioritise the cluster tags: prod-inference-1, batch-encoders, realtime-chat, ab-test-ml. I'll open a canary schedule for swap nights.

samir: Depot staffing note — weekend handovers require explicit pickup slot. If vendor wants release Sat/Sun we need advance 24h courier slot booked, otherwise Monday. Also cross-border courier from NL->DE may need extra docs.

maria: Who covers brokerage/duties while loaner? Vendor said vendor-proforma + credit later but customs can be sticky. Ask vendor for estimated duty exposure so finance can pre-approve float.

vendor-contact: Estimated duties exposure ~€2k per AWB if HS reclassifies (HPC parts 8471 vs GPUs 8473 debate). We advise keeping original HS on paperwork to avoid reclass, but customs can reopen on inspection. We can add cargo insurance (carrier insurance A) for €500/awb.

alex: Ok - plan proposal: 1) release 18 loaners from ams depot immediately, 2) vendor issues proforma + LOA naming Redwood Inference as temporary importer, 3) we pre-approve duty float up to €5k, 4) ops to schedule pick/slots and swap nights. Anyone object?

maria: +1 if vendor will commit to credit note within 30 days of receipt. Need SLA TAT in writing.

vendor-contact: We can commit to credit note within 30 calendar days from proof of return to vendor depot, subject to inspection. Addendum: for partial replace we recommend consolidating replacements onto single AWB where possible to reduce claims friction.

jx: Two operational asks: (a) can we get a pre-filled return manifest csv from vendor? (b) can they pre-authorize depot techs to flash firmware so loaners are ready out of the box?

vendor-contact: Yes to manifest. We'll attach this CSV template: 

```
serial,sku,model,reason,customer_ref
H200-12345,H200,H200-64GB,DOA,INC-9876
H200-23456,H200,H200-64GB,DOA,INC-9876
```

Firmware flash: depot can do a minimal boot test only. Full firmware imaging requires site SLA and additional charge (€45/unit).

samir: Ops note: imaging at depot is fine for canaries but we should keep defaults for batch fallback. Charging for imaging is ok but need sign-off.

maria: Also confirm whether replacement units are new or refurbished — that affects lifecycle accounting. Finance needs CAPEX vs OPEX classification.

vendor-contact: Replacements for this allocation will be new units unless flagged. Refurb only on end-of-life RMA.

alex: Great. Action items: vendor to send proforma + LOA + manifest CSV by EOD, ops (samir/jx) to book courier slots and prioritize clusters, finance (maria) to pre-approve duty float €5k. I'll update the incident ticket and tag customers for SLA expectations.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-9876 updated: loaner release 18 units requested; vendor docs pending. Next status check in 6h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
